confidence_notes: Model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or current prices; July 2026 levels are extrapolated. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable; alcohol (heavily taxed) and accommodation (wide variance) are less certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.4x and 1.9x) because direct price knowledge is weaker. LKR examples use about 300 LKR per USD. The FX value (0.7002 for 14 Oct 2026) came from a search summary attributed to RBA exchange-rate pages and was not verified against the RBA daily table; the summary's 15 Oct figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: South Asian regional basis: budget lodging and local meals benchmarked to tourist-oriented South Asian capitals such as Kathmandu, with drinks and the 3-star hotel anchor set higher to reflect Sri Lanka's alcohol taxation and Colombo's hotel stock.
